claim_en: Settled.govt.nz states that a bank or lender will usually want proof that property insurance has been arranged before settlement.
quote: will usually want proof that you’ve arranged property insurance before settlement
source_title: What property buyers need to know about insurance - settled.govt.nz
next_step_en: Ask your lender what insurance evidence it requires and get insurance quotes early.

claim_en: The Natural Hazards Commission building cover cap is generally $300,000 plus GST per natural hazard event; the private insurer covers repair costs above the cap.
quote: is called the building cover cap and is generally $300,000 plus GST
source_title: About natural hazards cover - Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake
next_step_en: Check your private insurance policy for cover above the Natural Hazards Commission cap.

claim_en: The unittitles.govt.nz short guide states that the body corporate must insure the unit title property to its full insurable value.
quote: must insure and keep insured the unit title property to its full insurable value
source_title: Short guide to unit titles (May 2024) - unittitles.govt.nz (MBIE)
next_step_en: Ask for the body corporate insurance policy and check whether you need separate cover for your unit and contents.
